title: Village lines 98
description: Have you ever played Lines 98 or Colored Lines? This is a retro version of the most adaptive board game of 1998. We present you with a village and garden style version of this game. Enjoy the game in a new way.
instructions: - Click on an element and then on an empty field if there is access to move then it will move - Collect five or more items of the same kind - The line can be vertical horizontal or diagonal - For collected lines you get points set your own records
